migration_definition: Every existing Hokkaido, Miyagi, Tokyo, and Fukuoka record-level linkage result is included through an explicit source file. Linked, partial, and not-linked records are all preserved. The inventory is exhaustive for the declared source registries and does not promote unresolved records or infer policy achievement.

sources.name: 北海道
sources.migration_boundary: All 108 indicator records are inventoried. Eighteen remain partial because target version, unit scale, indicator definition, numbering, or component structure prevents direct promotion.

sources.name: 宮城県
sources.migration_boundary: All 627 budget-project records are inventoried. Only exact project identity within the same measure, department, and office is linked; changed organizations, relisted projects, and unmatched settlement records remain partial or not linked.

sources.name: 東京都
sources.migration_boundary: All eight children-policy target groups are inventoried. Two remain partial because the official target list and policy review disagree on the reporting period or actual value and period.

sources.name: 福岡県
sources.migration_boundary: All 118 target records are inventoried. Revised target versions remain partial and targets absent from the FY2024 numeric-target table remain not linked pending another official actual source.
